wiki_article:
**🌑⬡ THE LUNAR ARM — EA-ARK-EMOJI-01-SHADOW** is a score and executable transform by Lee Sharks dated 10 March 2026, held in this record as a **metadata capture**.

It is the shadow component of the emoji-Ark triptych: **strategy** at #541, **the glyphic vehicle itself** at #556, and **the shadow** — the Operator // Shadow transform — at #540, with this record and #1331 preserving further states of it. The Lunar Arm is the archive's nocturnal countercurrent, and applying the Ark's operator system to it produces the Ark's own shadow rather than a separate object.

The record was assembled from a DataCite full-metadata capture after the termination. Its companion at **#1331**, recovered from a thinner Zenodo tombstone capture, preserves the same work at a different recovery tier — the archive holds both rather than merging them, because the difference between what a full capture preserves and what a tombstone does is itself the measurement.
